name: credit_limit_basic
description: AP Clerk requesting credit-limit block on sales orders. All four core pillars stated explicitly across 3 user turns.

history.content: Hi, I'd like to create a new NetSuite requirement ticket. Here's what I need: when an AP Clerk submits a sales order over the customer's credit limit, NetSuite should block approval and show a warning.
Got it. What problem does this solve?
Right now we have to chase invoices that should never have shipped. Couple of times a quarter we eat the loss. We want to avoid revenue leakage and stop processing orders that are over-credit.
Makes sense — does this apply to all subsidiaries?
All US subsidiaries for now. The credit team wants this to enforce the credit policy and reduce manual reconciliation work.

expected_pillars.action: Block sales order approval when over customer credit limit
expected_pillars.goal: Stop processing orders that exceed credit limit
expected_pillars.business_value: Avoid revenue leakage and reduce manual reconciliation
